title: Auditing LLM Program Search for Bermudan Stopping with Primal--Dual Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.14063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM program-search agents are usually judged by the score that drives their search. We study LLM-driven search over Python exercise policies for Bermudan options, an optimal stopping problem where a trusted evaluator owns the simulation and a dual upper bound~$U$. For any policy, $0 \le V^\star - L_\pi \le U - L_\pi$; we report Monte Carlo estimates of both bounds with their sampling error. We audit 24 generation attempts from two pipelines, a six-pair feedback-representation ablation, and a holdout evaluated after selection was frozen. No selected generated program improves on Ridge LSMC consistently or by more than Monte Carlo uncertainty; holdout gap scores lie within $0.002$ of it. translated_title: 基于原始-对偶证书的百慕大期权最优停时LLM程序搜索审计
translated_abstract: LLM程序搜索智能体通常以驱动其搜索过程的得分来评判。我们研究了LLM驱动的搜索方法，用于生成针对百慕大期权的Python行权策略，这是一个最优停时问题，其中可信的评估器掌握着模拟过程和对偶上界U。对于任意策略π，满足 0 ≤ V* - L_π ≤ U - L_π；我们报告了这两个界及其抽样误差的蒙特卡洛估计。我们审计了来自两条流水线的24次生成尝试、一组六对的反馈-表示消融实验，以及一个在搜索选择冻结后进行评估的保留数据集。结果显示，没有任何被选中的生成程序能够持续地、或在超出蒙特卡洛不确定性范围之外地改进Ridge LSMC基线；保留集上的差距得分与其相差不超过0.002。在六个一维看跌期权上，高精度二叉树基准表明Ridge LSMC已处于最优解的蒙特卡洛噪声范围内，并将估计差距的99%归因于对偶界本身的松弛，因此该对偶方法可以审计搜索的有效性，但无法认证搜索所取得的进展。
tldr: 该研究利用原始-对偶上下界证书审计LLM驱动的百慕大期权行权程序搜索，发现没有任何生成的程序能稳定超越Ridge LSMC基线，且对偶界虽能验证有效性但无法认证搜索取得的进展。
en_tdlr: This study audits LLM-driven program search for Bermudan option exercise policies using primal-dual bound certificates, finding that no generated program consistently improves on the Ridge LSMC baseline, and the dual bound can audit validity but cannot certify search progress.
